_about: Rules that are announced or in draft but not yet in force. The monthly rules check reads each item against its source; when an item becomes final, its pack gets a new edition or answer and the item leaves this list.

items.title: EU pharmaceutical legislation reform (new Directive on the Union code for medicinal products for human use, and new Regulation on Union procedures and the EMA)
items.status: Adopted by the Council at first reading on 28 September 2026; the European Parliament's second-reading approval is still to come, then publication in the Official Journal.
items.expected: Entry into force 20 days after publication in the Official Journal; most provisions apply about 24 months later. The Commission is to adopt delegated acts on variations under the new law.
items.app: The EU pack stays on the variations framework in force (Regulation (EC) No 1234/2008 as amended by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1701, and the guidelines that apply from 15 January 2026). A new EU edition is added when the delegated acts on variations are published.
items.trigger: Publication of the delegated acts on variations

sources.title: LexisNexis news, 28 September 2026: Council of the EU adopts pharmaceutical reform package
Matheson, 30 September 2026: EU Council adopts new EU Pharma Package

items.title: India: draft G.S.R. 97(E) of 2 February 2026 (post-approval changes under the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019)
items.status: Draft. No final notification found as of the check date.
items.expected: Levels I to III for quality changes to new drugs once notified as final.
items.app: Shown only as a what-if: switch on the draft rules in a case. When it is notified as final, the India answer for chemical drugs moves from case by case to the rule.
items.trigger: Final notification in the Gazette of India

sources.title: Medical Dialogues: Centre proposes risk-based approval system for post-approval drug changes under NDCT Rules

items.title: India: similar draft of 9 March 2026 for licences under the Drugs Rules, 1945
items.expected: The same levels for products licensed under the Drugs Rules, 1945.
items.app: Not modelled separately; the what-if follows G.S.R. 97(E).
items.trigger: Final notification in the Gazette of India

sources.title: Medical Dialogues: Centre proposes risk-based approval system for post-approval drug changes under NDCT Rules

items.title: Canada: ICH Q12 for pharmaceutical drugs (Pharmaceutical Drugs Directorate) and established conditions
items.status: Announced. PACMPs for biologic and radiopharmaceutical products are accepted since 13 August 2026; the date for pharmaceutical drugs is to be communicated in 2026, and established conditions later.
items.expected: PACMPs for pharmaceutical drugs, then established conditions.
items.app: Pharmaceutical drugs have no PACMP route in the Canada pack; biologics do.
items.trigger: Health Canada notice with an implementation date

sources.title: Health Canada: Post-notice of compliance changes (ICH Q12 and Q14 notice)

items.title: China: CDE draft Technical Guideline for Post-approval Change Management Protocols for Chemical Drugs
items.status: Draft, published for consultation in 2025. No final version found as of the check date.
items.expected: A protocol route for chemical drugs: agree the studies and acceptance criteria first, then make the change at a lower category.
items.app: The China pack has no PACMP route; protocol changes show "Not used in China yet".

sources.title: Summary of the 2025 draft (Shandong University Zibo pharmaceutical news)
